schools.name: AECI 2 (NYC Charter School for Architecture, Engineering & Construction Industries) (Grades 6)
schools.official_name: AECI 2 (NYC Charter School for Architecture, Engineering & Construction Industries)
schools.source: NYC Charter School Center FINDER; NYC Planning GeoSearch (location); NYC school district and 2020 neighborhood maps

notes: campus name does not match a license name in the NYSED directory (networks often run several campuses under one license)

admissions.how_to_apply: Apply with the school's own application, or the NYC Charter School Center Common Online Charter School Application.
admissions.eligibility: Open to all New York City children entering the grades the school serves. Charter schools must admit students of all kinds and cannot use admissions tests.
admissions.deadline_note: By law the deadline can't be earlier than April 1; some schools accept applications later. Confirm with the school.
admissions.lottery_note: If applications exceed seats, a random lottery is held (typically April–May).
admissions.lottery_preferences: Returning students; Siblings of students already enrolled; Students living in Community School District 9. Some schools also prefer English language learners, students with disabilities, or students eligible for free or reduced-price lunch.

contact_costs.transportation: NYC DOE school bus or student OMNY card, based on grade and walking distance. Confirm with the school.

admissions.how_to_apply: Apply with Success Academy's own online application ("Apply Now" on the network website).
admissions.eligibility: Open to all New York City children entering the grades the school serves. Charter schools must admit students of all kinds and cannot use admissions tests.

admissions.lottery_note: If applications exceed seats, a random lottery is held (typically April–May).

contact_costs.transportation: NYC DOE school bus or student OMNY card, based on grade and walking distance. Confirm with the school.

admissions.deadline_note: By law the deadline can't be earlier than April 1; some schools accept applications later. Confirm with the school.
admissions.lottery_note: If applications exceed seats, a random lottery is held (typically April–May).

contact_costs.transportation: NYC DOE school bus or student OMNY card, based on grade and walking distance. Confirm with the school.
